**Ukraine: how applications changed.** The extract records 959,747 applications during 2000–2025. Annual volume peaked at 289,913 in 2014, compared with 40,497 in 2025. Applications in 2025 were 108% higher than in 2019 (19,433). Applications in 2025 were 12% lower than in 2024 (45,866). In 2025, the leading destinations were France (13,070; 32%), Poland (6,992; 17%), Russian Federation (3,355; 8.3%). France received 32% of this origin's applications in 2025, versus 7.5% in 2019: a change in destination distribution, not evidence that the same people moved between asylum systems.

Across receiving countries, in 2025, the substantive protection rate was 71%, across 32,760 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 20% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 18.4 percentage points lower than in 2024 (89%).
